headline: Chip and AI Stocks Turn Higher by Lunch

writeup.headline: Chip and AI Stocks Turn Higher by Lunch
writeup.summary: This morning's big story was CoreWeave's Earnings Calm AI-Spending Fears. The big swing: chip and AI stocks slid early, then turned around after 9:46 AM and are now higher on the day — SeeNews points to “Bucharest stocks turn red, OMV Petrom leads blue-chip decliners”. The AI names are up and the average stock is up: stocks are moving together. Cyclical sectors are leading defensive ones, and the S&P has held its gains all session.

themes.headline: Chip and AI stocks climbed back from an early slide
themes.detail: Up 2.7% at 9:46 AM, now +6.4%; biggest gainers since: Advanced Micro Devices, Oracle. In the news: “Bucharest stocks turn red, OMV Petrom leads blue-chip decliners” (SeeNews).

themes.headline: S&P has held its gains
themes.detail: Low at 9:46 AM, high at 11:58 AM; +0.5% since the open.

themes.headline: Technology leads, Cons. Discretionary lags
themes.detail: Since the open: Technology +1.2%, Cons. Discretionary -0.4%.
